properties.name: Adds `capability_has_evidence()` — a predicate, so callers stop naming `CapabilityVerification::Unchecked` to compare against a variant. That naming was the third hop of the module cycle artifact → temporal → verify → artifact. Which VARIANT a capability is in is this module's business; whether it has evidence is the question everyone else asks. No behaviour changed and no types moved.
